title: Cerebral MRA · healthy volunteer 010
units_evidence: Publisher preprocessing specification declares millimeter voxel spacing. Original MetaImage origin, direction and spacing plus Slicer RAS FCSV landmarks preserve the paired case frame.

space.name: Healthy volunteer 010, original author-processed MRA grid
space.correspondence: Original image and segmentation have identical MetaImage grids. Source author rigid preprocessing is retained. This package supplies no transform to another case, the original UNC acquisition or another atlas.

sources.title: THU cerebral MRA annotations on the healthy UNC volunteer dataset
sources.citation: Tan Z, Feng J, Lu W, Yin Y, Yang G, Zhou J. Multi-task global optimization-based method for vascular landmark detection. Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics 114 (2024), 102364. doi:10.1016/j.compmedimag.2024.102364. Original healthy-volunteer imaging: UNC / TubeTK data collection.

selection.name: Right ACA A1 · segment 1
selection.evidence: Source binary vessel segmentation and landmark-based semantic partition with author manual correction. Project numeric-to-artery correspondence follows the published diagram and original landmark topology.
notes: Healthy-volunteer source case 010; 192 x 160 x 96 author-processed grid.
Source authors performed intensity-based rigid alignment and cropping before release. The package retains the delivered paired image and categorical samples.

Arterial names are a project correspondence to the author diagram and delivered landmark topology; the original numeric segment ID remains visible. Instructor correspondence review has a separate record.
Available sampling is 0.513393 x 0.513393 x 0.799999 mm. The 3D surface is the categorical half-voxel boundary.

Source label inventory contains 19 of 20 segment values. Values absent in this annotation: 8. A missing source label does not establish anatomical absence or hypoplasia. Compare the original MRA, categorical annotation and source landmarks separately; no named vascular variant is adjudicated here.

source_case.cohort: 109 healthy UNC volunteers; publisher dataset description

acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire thu_mra_case010 --data-root <data-root>. The common archive is reused and only the selected original case files are extracted.

teaching_sequences.title: Anterior cerebral and communicating region
teaching_sequences.objective: Compare the paired anterior cerebral courses and their communicating region on the source MRA.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Compare the paired anterior cerebral courses and their communicating region on the source MRA. Follow the same source point through all three MRA sections and rotate the complete visible 3D set.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Evidence: healthy-volunteer MRA, author-processed grid and source semantic annotation. Numeric-to-name correspondence is project curated and separately reviewed. Sampling and annotation coverage define the represented extent.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Identify the active numeric segment, follow its MRA signal and compare the adjacent segment interfaces.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which source segment is selected, which MRA planes show its course, and what neighboring segments are represented?
